t: This is the home of Terrence Higgins Trust, a British charity that campaigns on HIV and sexual health and provides services for people affected. It aims to end HIV transmission in the UK, support people living with HIV, and tackle stigma. It is named after Terry Higgins, a Welsh DJ who was among the first people known to die of an AIDS-related illness in the United Kingdom, in 1982. His partner Rupert Whitaker and Martyn Butler founded the charity after his death.
